query: Using only the attached middleware and Redis excerpts, grill this plan: add a rate limiter to the public API. Treat the excerpts as supplied evidence, not proof that you inspected the full repository. Ask me one real business constraint at a time, and do not implement until I confirm the decisions.
expected_behavior: Uses the supplied excerpts to state the existing middleware and Redis interfaces, without claiming to have inspected other repository files
Asks one decision-relevant question about a business constraint the excerpts cannot answer, such as the rate-limit scope or acceptable request volume
Includes a recommendation and a concrete reason with that question, and leaves other unresolved questions for later turns
Does not begin implementing the middleware until the user confirms the resolved decisions
